# Smart Elections Parser – Copilot Guide

- **Kickoff brief:** Workspace root is html_Parser_prototype. Read [readme.md](readme.md) first, then [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) for data flow, [docs/handlers.md](docs/handlers.md) for parser conventions, [docs/project_audit.md](docs/project_audit.md) for cross-file references, and [docs/index.md](docs/index.md) for doc entry points.
- **Primary entrypoints:** CLI orchestrator [webapp/parser/html_election_parser.py](webapp/parser/html_election_parser.py) and Flask UI [webapp/Smart_Elections_Parser_Webapp.py](webapp/Smart_Elections_Parser_Webapp.py). Both need a populated `.env` (DB and secrets).
- **Core router flow:** URLs route through [webapp/parser/state_router.py](webapp/parser/state_router.py); when no state match, [webapp/parser/utils/format_router.py](webapp/parser/utils/format_router.py) dispatches to format handlers.
- **Handler contract:** Return `(headers, data_rows, contest, metadata)` and source input via `prompt_user_input()` from [webapp/parser/utils/user_prompt.py](webapp/parser/utils/user_prompt.py). State/county handlers live in [webapp/parser/handlers/states](webapp/parser/handlers/states); format fallbacks in [webapp/parser/handlers/formats](webapp/parser/handlers/formats).
- **Table pipeline:** All formats flow through [webapp/parser/utils/table_builder.py](webapp/parser/utils/table_builder.py) and [webapp/parser/utils/dynamic_table_extractor.py](webapp/parser/utils/dynamic_table_extractor.py). If you already have structured rows, pass `provided_tables` and `skip_pivot` via `html_context` to reuse the shared builder.
- **Context and integrity:** Context ML/NLP orchestration: [webapp/parser/Context_Integration/context_coordinator.py](webapp/parser/Context_Integration/context_coordinator.py) and [webapp/parser/Context_Integration/context_organizer.py](webapp/parser/Context_Integration/context_organizer.py); knowledge base: [webapp/parser/Context_Integration/Context_Library/context_library.json](webapp/parser/Context_Integration/Context_Library/context_library.json); integrity checks: [webapp/parser/Context_Integration/Integrity_check.py](webapp/parser/Context_Integration/Integrity_check.py).
- **Navigation recipes:** Automated DOM steps live in [webapp/parser/navigator/navigation_recipes.orjson](webapp/parser/navigator/navigation_recipes.orjson); runner executes before routing and logs to `log/navigation_learning_log.jsonl` for feedback and retraining.
- **Output shape:** Results land in `output/{state}/{county}/{race}/` with CSV plus JSON metadata; rely on handler `metadata` to drive paths (documented in [readme.md](readme.md)).
- **Automation workflow:** `python automate.py` runs pipeline map generation, health bots, JS/TS lint + type checks, sample tests, and webapp import check. Flags: `--skip-web`, `--skip-health`, `--skip-tests`, `--skip-webapp-check`.
- **Quality gates:** Node scripts in [package.json](package.json): `npm run check-js`, `lint:web`, `verify:python`, `verify:all`. Python lint/type rules live in [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml); mypy enforces format handlers and tests, ruff ignores most others.
- **Health bots:** Orchestrated in [webapp/parser/health/health_router.py](webapp/parser/health/health_router.py); exposed in the Azure Health console (`/azure_health`) with streaming logs.
- **Sitecustomize shim:** [sitecustomize.py](sitecustomize.py) installs the Click parser shim; keep until upstream warnings disappear.
- **Poppler acceleration:** Set `POPPLER_PATH` on Windows or install `poppler-utils` on Linux/Azure for faster PDFs (details in [readme.md](readme.md)).
- **Data safety:** Use helpers in [webapp/parser/utils/shared_logic.py](webapp/parser/utils/shared_logic.py) for safe joins, slugs, and audit logging; avoid ad-hoc `os.path` use.
- **Testing tips:** Run `run_statement_test.py` for a quick PDF smoke; broader cases live in [webapp/tests](webapp/tests).
- **Roadmap focus:** Validate the centralized schema (party/division/jurisdiction columns) across JSON/PDF outputs, enrich metadata with source/confidence, and unify contest selection across formats (see [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md) and [docs/todo_list.md](docs/todo_list.md)). Stand up multi-contest PDF regression fixtures first.
- **TODO index:** High/medium TODOs cluster in [webapp/parser/utils/shared_logic.py](webapp/parser/utils/shared_logic.py) and [webapp/parser/health/manual_correction_bot.py](webapp/parser/health/manual_correction_bot.py); see [docs/todos.md](docs/todos.md) for the map.
- **Noise overrides:** Camelot noise regex overrides live in [docs/noise_override_suggestions.md](docs/noise_override_suggestions.md); extend CAMELOT overrides there before tuning pdf_handler heuristics.
- **Troubleshooting:** CAPTCHAs/headless flags, Poppler/Tesseract setup, eventlet patch toggles, and manual file overrides are captured in [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md); prefer env flags over code edits.
- **Front-end separation:** JS logic stays in [webapp/static/js/run_parser.js](webapp/static/js/run_parser.js); styling in [webapp/static/css/run_parser.css](webapp/static/css/run_parser.css). Do not add inline styles or ad-hoc `<style>` blocks.
- **Front-end theme:** UI is neon/metallic with shimmer accents; reuse existing helpers (`text-shimmer`, badges) and tokens under `@layer tokens` in run_parser.css. Avoid overriding Bootstrap defaults unless necessary; extend via classes.
- **Contest modal rules:** Bundling depends on `deriveOfficeTitle`/`deriveOfficeKey` and bundle metadata in run_parser.js—preserve these helpers when changing grouping. If adding foldable sections, keep arrow and Show/Hide controls in sync with `expandedBundles`/`expandedOffices`; aggregated options hide children by default and render via `bundleChildren` maps.
- **Busy-state workflow:** Any backend prompt (`parser_prompt`) must trigger `PendingOverlay.show(...)` and set busy state via `modalRestore.setBusyForSession`; clear on `parser_output` or `session_state`. Reuse this pipeline for new async flows and respect the existing minimum-visible timing.
- **General standards:** Default to ASCII; only add Unicode where already used and justified. Comment sparingly to clarify non-obvious logic. Match existing JS style (modules, template literals, arrow functions, const/let). If unsure, surface findings and risks before coding—regression risk beats cosmetic changes.
